title: #19 Dennis Leech, Judge Developments + Partservice Ford Sierra RS500, BTCC 1991
note: Low to medium confidence. 2026-11-16: first 1991 photo found: supertouring.co.uk 1991 entrants gallery, page 3, 'leech_91.jpg' (https://web.archive.org/web/2012/http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991_entrants_3.html, image http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991/leech_91.jpg, 230x160, saved in teams/_series/ask_permission/on_track), left side, front 3/4, on track. It shows a white Sierra RS500 with: PARTSERVICE in one word under the side windows (PART red, SERVICE dark blue), from mid-door back over the rear wheel; a yellow AUTELA panel with dark letters at mid-door; a red lettering row lower on the door behind the number (unreadable, drawn as the 1992 car's 'The Motor Factors EXETER 215935'); ESSO board and 19 at the front of the door; a dark word on the front wing (kept as YOKOHAMA from the 1992 car); a red sticker with white letters on the front bumper (front face, not drawn); dark grey cross-spoke wheels with a light lip (the 1992 car had gold wheels). No dark beltline stripe on the photo, so it was removed. Positions read by wheel-centre fractions from a small, foreshortened photo. JUDGE DEVELOPMENTS on the rear quarter and CHAMPION on the sill stay guesses from the 1992 photo (Super Touring Register 4746, https://supertouringregister.com/picture/4746/). Earlier base layout from the BBC grid graphics (A_grid_r03_donington_09, A_grid_r04_thruxton_sharp_08). Also seen: Getty LAT 2201201286 (Oulton Park 1990, white car, front only). Logos: none placed; no logo file for Partservice, Autela or Judge Developments.
